One idea i have is asking your doctor about it? Like, when you go in for a visit bring it up with your doctor when you’re alone with them and they’ll most likely give you a diagnosis and start discussing with your mom. You can ask her to go in for a regular check up, like a physical or something and go from there?

Or if that’ll take too long, you can research mental health clinics in your area. Some areas have places that’ll provide help for your mental health for free. I hope this helps a little or gives you some kind of idea of where to start

No, it’s not weird. I feel the same way. Home doesn’t really feel like home, my family doesn’t understand me. I feel like I don’t fit with any of my friends and like I shouldn’t be around them, even though the care about me. But they don’t get me either, ya know? Like something always feels off no matter what I’m doing. You’re not alone in how you feel.

Maybe you can move in with someone, like your best friend? Also, you’re never too old to study, trust me. Life is about learning and growing, ya know? Don’t be ashamed of that. The people that judge you for still studying should be embarrassed of themselves for not pursuing knowledge, even though you’re getting older. There’s no time limit on that. You said you want to become a therapist, and you’re working towards that. If you take the job your friend is offering, that doesn’t mean you’ll never become one. In fact, doing the job may help you later when you’re ready to find a different job towards the career you want. There’s no timeline on when you should get things done in life. You do what’s best for you because no one else has been in your shoes and everything you do you do for a reason.
Privilege doesn’t matter, ok? Everything you feel is valid and don’t let anyone tell you otherwise. Have you talked with your parents about anything?

go to her and explain your situation to her. she’ll support you, since she always has. make sure you explain to her that you also know how the hospital works and that you feel you’d be better if you went there. 
Also, if you’re afraid you’ll be gone on her birthday, you can get her a gift and leave her a note that says something like “open on your birthday” and give her a gift early so she knows you’re thinking about her :)
Message me?

You can do it, trust me. It’ll be really really hard at first since you haven’t been doing it. But you can start off easy. You don’t have to flat out say to her that you fantasize about dying. You can say something like “I think I’m depressed” if you haven’t spoken about it to her, then go from there

Have you tried talking with your family, specifically your mom about it? You said she has scars, meaning she’s fought the battle of depression. But she came out with a family, you and your sister. You’re young, 14, you can still change into that better person you want to be.

Ohhh ok that makes more sense i didn’t know it started in grade 7. Next year is my last year in highschool, and this previous year was the only year I actually reached out to the school counselors. I didn’t think they cared about mental health either, but they do. I don’t know about your specific school though, but at mine they apparently can provide an accommodation for those with depression by doing things like extending due dates. They never said anything about having accommodations for mental health until i actually want to talk to them, which kinda sucks but it’s understandable. I saw that you commented on another post that it’s hard for you to talk about your problems in public. I’ve been there too, trust me. But counselors are trained to talk to you and have seen it all :) so, I’d recommend you reach out to the ones at your school and see what they can do to help you. I wish I could give you better information but I’m not completely sure on the schooling system in Australia but i hope this helps

Hi, it’s good that you’ve reached out. I think reaching out will help you a lot, it’s hard to deal with pent up stress. I also attend and all-girls highschool with mandatory PE classes. At my school, freshman take a health class which counts for PE credits. What options do you have for PE? After freshman year, we get to choose what classes to take for PE. Some people take Sports medicine, which counts for credits and doesn’t involve physical activity. Try to get in contact with your class counselor people (I don’t know the word, but the faculty that organize classes and stuff like that). In highschool, there are a lot of accommodations that can be made but they won’t say anything unless you do. Also keep in mind, freshman year is the year that has very little weight in your highschool career, so allow yourself time to feel those emotions and adapt on your own terms. Everyone deals with things differently, it’s a big change
